verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a no-training policy, a training opt-out, or any commitment about whether customer traces are used to train AI models. Self-hosting keeps trace data in your own environment, but that is a data-residency control, not a training-use control, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: a documented policy or setting that prevents customer data from being used for model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
